v4_defect_fixed: V4 skipped the content of a LATE_PACK and set the next previous_chain to UNRECOMPUTABLE; any UNREVEALED row also nulled final_chain. Every later pack then failed the cross-pack seam check and was reported INVALID_PACK. On the public tree as of 2026-10-17 V4 reports 11 penalized days (47,520 misses); 7 of them (2026-10-03…08, 2026-10-12) are this artifact. V5 also never penalizes a day for an unavailable predecessor, treats unanchored or post-as-of evidence as pending/missing by contract time, separates demonstrated invalid bytes from unavailable evidence, and authenticates its own release and the new rule documents.
